description: Black plays 2...Nf6, avoiding the early queen sortie entirely. After 3.d4 Nxd5 Black steers into Lasker's rock-solid system: the knight reroutes to b6, the bishop fianchettoes to g7, and Black's position has no weaknesses.

lines.description: The Lasker Scandinavian: 3.d4 Nxd5 4.Nf3 g6. Black reroutes the knight to b6, fianchettoes the bishop, and castles into a fortress. White keeps the space advantage with c4 and Nc3, but Black's position is famously hard to crack — the Icelandic Gambit now lives on as a separate tactical variation.
